Who is good and does good,

and is the ruler of His world to do in it as He wills, … as all His ways are just,

and is the ruler of His world to do in it as He wills,
as all His ways are just,
that all is His and we are His people and His servants,
and in everything we are obligated to thank Him and bless Him,
Who repairs the breaches in Israel,
He will repair this breach in Israel for life.

p: I know a baraita, as it was taught: What is the order of reclining? When there are two divans … the greater … reclines first,
I know a baraita, as it was taught: What is the order of reclining? When there are two divans on which they would recline, the greater of the two people reclines first,
When there are three divans, … the greatest … reclines first,
When there are three divans, the greatest of the three reclines first,
